timing: Pure personal turns, distinct active Pure global turns
basic: Additional resolved GGS Dragon within two following Pure turns AND net increase in simultaneous GGS Dragons or >=5 offensive power, or >=2 hand/Treasure resources without losing offensive power, against immediate Dragon-1 state
strong: 2+ resolved GGS Dragon creations in one Pure turn
extra combat plus net >=5 offensive power growth and GGS Dragon creation
2+ combat-generated cards plus 2+ Treasure creations with continued GGS production and >=2 cards left
threatening: 20 actual unblocked attacking combat power after legal blocks, after ignition
15 actual Pure combat damage to opponents in one Pure turn after ignition
dependency: Natural requires no material amplifier in path to threshold. Amplified requires actual contributing amplifier effect; amplifier-dependent requires direct contribution necessary to cross threshold at observed time. Uncertain causal cases stay unclassified instead of guessing. Counterfactual attribution is observational, not a randomized ablation.
stabilization: At least 64 valid games and 40 ignited games; latest two increments differ <=10 percentage points for conversion/basic/strong/threatening and natural/dependent; timing medians <=1 Pure turn difference; leading stall reason unchanged. Report Wilson intervals. Continue if unstable, bounded at 128 with explicit inconclusive qualification if needed.
clarification: Before analyzing experimental batch 1, tightened board threat evidence to actual unblocked attackers rather than assuming flying bodies will connect.
